title: Measure cache-aware prompt layout as an explicit experiment
narrative: Taloneth toggles cache-aware layout on and off. When enabled, stable policy blocks should sit in a stable prefix separate from the dynamic tail; when disabled, everything stays in the dynamic tail with diagnostics.
implementation:
`compile_cache_aware_layout` / `CacheLayout` under `CtxFlags.cache_aware_layout` — an independent experiment toggle with prefix identity diagnostics.

Covers: CTX-09.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/cache_layout_experiment.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
